__comment: The Carpenter's own workbench (doc 293; the chopping block, doc 301 B): a thick slab hewn flat on top, half of a great log with its round side down, one end let into a stump with its bark on, level with the slab, the other on two peeled log legs with a rail and a stretcher. Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs.
Carpenters make it at the crude workbench from three matching logs; it keeps their wood. The slab's top stands 1.125 blocks high inside the 3 x 1 collision envelope.

Its window's Craft items opens the Carpenter's page at the first recipe made here (recipes.json names this bench as their workshop); their goods lie on the slab where it is nearest the Carpenter, crafting_surface_inset inside its edges.
description: A thick slab hewn flat on top, one end let into a bark stump, the chopping block, the other on two peeled legs: the Carpenter's own workbench. Occupies a 3 by 1 space and is worked from either long side.
